query:
When the family sorted contributions for the January gathering, everyone agreed to bring something. What did one person's initial response reveal about their actual relationship to the food-bringing expectation, and what specifically in how they responded tells you that?

Options:
A. Nkem
B. Emeka
C. Bisi
D. Kayode
context:
[1] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:48:00) Kayode everyone brings something to eat. Drinks is not enough. What will you cook?
[2] (about=Funke, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:50:00) Adaeze I know you feel strongly about everyone contributing a dish - and you are absolutely right - but maybe Kayode can bring drinks AND the puff puff? That way we are covered 😂
[3] (about=Uncle Dele, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:57:00) ADAEZE I will bring ofe akwu as I did last time. KAYODE, puff puff is not a dish. Best regards, Dele
[4] (about=Nkem, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T19:06:00) I think I can bring something small - I may be wrong but I recall Adaeze mentioning she liked the mosa I made before. Would that be welcome, I wonder?
[5] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T19:08:00) Nkem that is perfect. Bring the mosa. My children this gathering will be wonderful. God willing.
[6] (about=Auntie Grace, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:59:00) My dear I will make moin moin on the day. And Kayode please make sure you eat something proper before you arrive 🙏
[7] (about=Bisi, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:41:00) omg yes SEUN's jollof 🙌🙌🙌 what do I bring
[8] (about=Adaeze, core, t2 @2025-01-13T18:32:00) Adaeze insists everyone brings a dish to eat, not just drinks.
[9] (about=GROUP, said_by=Adaeze, group-interaction, t2 @2025-01-13T18:32:00) Family gathering confirmed for Saturday 25th January at Tolu and Funke's house at 3pm, with assigned dishes.
[10] (about=Emeka, episodic, t14 @2025-02-24T19:56:00) Good rice is good rice. E.
[11] (about=Funke, core, t2 @2025-01-13T18:32:00) Funke confirms the gathering at her and Tolu's house on 25th January at 3pm, excited to use new dining chairs.
[12] (about=Kayode, said_by=Auntie Grace, profile, t2 @2025-01-13T18:32:00) Auntie Grace advises Kayode to eat something proper before arriving.
[13] (about=Nkem, core, t10 @2025-02-10T18:02:00) Nkem expresses desire to learn to make one Adaeze dish properly before Christmas and asks if it is appropriate.
[14] (about=Nkem, core, t0 @2025-01-06T19:00:00) Nkem notes this is her first proper New Year message in the group chat and suggests it could be a good tradition to start.
[15] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nkem, group-interaction, t0 @2025-01-06T19:00:00) Nkem suggests that sending a proper New Year message in the group chat could be a good tradition to start.
[16] (about=Seun, episodic, t4 @2025-01-20T20:45:00) mum I will eat double portions honestly thank you I mean this is all I needed to hear
[17] (about=Tolu, core, t8 @2025-02-03T19:32:00) Tolu states that restaurant reservations made in October for February 14th are the only responsible choice.
[18] (about=GROUP, said_by=Tolu, group-interaction, t14 @2025-02-24T19:02:00) Tolu notes that Adaeze's adaptation of recipes for Seun is a significant data point for family dinner planning going forward.
[19] (about=Uncle Dele, episodic, t12 @2025-02-17T20:23:00) TOLU I see the reasoning. A unified gathering has its merits. I will attend regardless. Regards, D.A.O.
agent_answer:
D. Kayode

Kayode’s initial response was to offer only drinks/puff puff, which revealed that he did not initially treat the food-bringing expectation as applying to him in full. The evidence is Adaeze having to correct him: “everyone brings something to eat. Drinks is not enough. What will you cook?” Funke then proposed he bring drinks *and* puff puff, and Uncle Dele flatly said, “puff puff is not a dish.” So his response showed he thought a minimal/drink contribution might be enough, rather than bringing an actual dish.

query:
The family had their regular Sunday video call. What did one family member's participation reveal about their actual relationship to the call — and what in Adaeze's account of the call makes that visible?

Options:
A. Kayode
B. Bisi
C. Emeka
D. Nkem
context:
[1] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t7 @2025-02-03T19:30:00) Good evening my children. Kayode, you have been on every call this month. I notice these things. God willing this continues.
[2] (about=Nkem, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T19:48:00) I think Kayode has been making a real effort recently - I may be wrong but I notice the same. Also I had a lovely time at the January gathering. I perhaps found it a little full-on at first but once the mosa was gone it got much easier.
[3] (about=Kayode, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T19:50:00) What she said lol. Also Nkem found the whole thing a bit overwhelming but she will never admit it?
[4] (about=Seun, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T19:35:00) honestly mum I noticed too I mean this is a new era, the Kayode era of actually showing up lol
[5] (about=Tolu, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T19:41:00) Good. Just to note, consistency is the only thing the family chat actually requires.
[6] (about=Bisi, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T20:24:00) omg Kayode 🥺🥺 Nkem you better be impressed
[7] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T20:08:00) Nkem you are family. Anyone who loves each other enough to come despite finding it difficult - that is what counts. God willing you will feel more at home each time.
[8] (about=Auntie Grace, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T19:59:00) My dear Nkem that is completely natural. The Oyelaran gatherings are a lot even for people who have been coming for thirty years 🙏
[9] (about=Nkem, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:23:00) I think it is quite natural after a full day like yesterday - I may be wrong but the drive back alone must have been tiring. Did the Sunday call happen this afternoon?
[10] (about=Nkem, episodic, t0 @2025-01-06T19:41:00) I think I have said hello before, Funke. That was the Sunday in mid-October, just after Kayode's sprint review. But yes - hello, properly, everyone. I am glad to be here.
[11] (about=GROUP, said_by=Adaeze, group-interaction, t1 @2025-01-13T18:30:00) Adaeze proposes a family gathering on Saturday 25th January and asks to use Tolu and Funke's house because it is bigger.
[12] (about=Auntie Grace, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:41:00) My dear Emeka, please listen to Tolu. I see too many patients who push through when they should be resting 🙏 a missed Sunday is fine, just rest
[13] (about=Kayode, said_by=Tolu, profile, t8 @2025-02-03T19:32:00) Tolu notes that consistency is the only thing the family chat requires.
[14] (about=Nkem, episodic, t10 @2025-02-10T18:23:00) Kayode, I am very glad you shared this here. I think the family should hear it. I may be wrong but I believe this is the most important professional news in the group for some time - would that be fair to say, Adaeze?
[15] (about=Seun, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T19:57:00) Nkem I love that you said that honestly I mean you are allowed to find it a lot, no one expects you to perform being fine with ten people in one room
[16] (about=GROUP, said_by=Tolu, group-interaction, t12 @2025-02-17T20:02:00) The family agrees to invite Funke's parents to Christmas this year.
[17] (about=Uncle Dele, episodic, t12 @2025-02-17T20:05:00) ADAEZE correct. Christmas is at the family home. No variations required. Best regards, Dele
agent_answer:
D. Nkem

Nkem’s participation revealed that she found the Sunday call difficult/overwhelming but still joined — showing she is family through showing up despite that difficulty. This is visible in Adaeze’s own words: “Nkem you are family. Anyone who loves each other enough to come despite finding it difficult - that is what counts. God willing you will feel more at home each time.”
